## Download

| Your device | File | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| 💻 **Mac**, macOS 12 or newer | **ClipSync-mac.zip** | Open it, then open **ClipSync** and follow its window. |
| 📱 **Android**, Android 10 or newer | **ClipSync.apk** | Easiest: scan the code in the Mac's setup window with your phone's camera. |
| 🎩 Alfred *(optional)* | ClipSync.alfredworkflow | Only if you use Alfred with the Powerpack. Install the Mac app first. |

New to ClipSync? The [setup guide]({{REPO_URL}}#readme) walks you through everything, including what to do if macOS or Android shows a warning.
